integrity_notes: Two independent deterministic finite counting methods agree on all 17-by-17 exact rooted-cluster histograms for both graphs.
The exact all-parameter stochastic comparison follows from nonnegative integer Bernstein coefficients, not from simulation.
scientific_limitations: The stochastic comparison concerns only the sixteen-vertex Shrikhande and 4-by-4 rook graphs under uniform independent site percolation.
No extension to bond percolation, heterogeneous site probabilities, or an infinite-graph critical behavior is asserted.
Independent scientific validation and exhaustive historical priority assessment have not been performed.
title: Strict rooted-cluster stochastic dominance for site percolation on two cospectral networks
